te: Studying state enterprises, reserve power and the transmission grid
se: The committee held a study session on the role of state enterprises in energy security, such as the reserve margin and managing the transmission grid, with EGAT explaining the power system and Thailand's Enhanced Single Buyer structure.
it: Study session on state enterprises, reserve power and the grid (EGAT)

te: Biomass report chapters, the small dam in Nan, and hydrogen in transport
se: The renewable energy subcommittee considered chapters 4 and 5 of its draft report on renewable energy for clean air. The electricity prices subcommittee heard the Department of Alternative Energy Development and Efficiency (DEDE) on the complaint about the small hydropower dam in Nan, and the hydrogen subcommittee heard an energy institute for industry and the Office of Transport and Traffic Policy and Planning (OTP).
it: Draft report on renewable energy for clean air (chapters 4–5)
Complaint about a small hydropower dam, Nan (DEDE)
Legal measures for hydrogen (energy institute for industry, OTP)

te: Studying energy price structures: electricity tariffs and the oil fund
se: The committee held a study session on energy price structures with the Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) and the Oil Fuel Fund Office, covering how electricity tariffs are regulated under the Energy Industry Act B.E. 2007 and the role of the Oil Fuel Fund.
it: Study session on energy price structures (ERC, Oil Fuel Fund Office)

te: Draft report on renewable energy for clean air, and hydrogen laws
se: The renewable energy subcommittee considered its draft report “Renewable energy for fair and sustainable clean air in Thailand: a case study of biomass fuel”. The electricity prices subcommittee set a date to consider the complaint about the small dam in Nan, and the hydrogen subcommittee heard the private sector and the Hydrogen Association of Thailand on legal measures.
it: Draft report on renewable energy for clean air: biomass fuel
Legal measures to develop hydrogen (private sector and association)

te: Studying natural gas and petroleum security and world oil prices
se: The committee held a study session on natural gas and petroleum security, such as gas supply from the Gulf of Thailand and Myanmar, LNG imports and world oil prices, with the Department of Mineral Fuels and PTT Public Company Limited explaining Thailand's petroleum production, exploration blocks under production sharing contracts and the Thailand–Malaysia joint development area.
it: Study session on natural gas and petroleum security (Department of Mineral Fuels, PTT)

te: Biomass report, a small hydropower dam in Nan, and hydrogen and greenhouse gases
se: The renewable energy subcommittee considered its summary report on renewing contracts for firm biomass power plants, with proposals on fuel, power purchase prices, farmer groups and reducing PM2.5. The electricity prices subcommittee considered a complaint asking for help with the effects of a small hydropower dam project in Wiang Sa District, Nan, and the hydrogen subcommittee studied the country's greenhouse gas reduction policy and the use of hydrogen and ammonia.
it: Summary report on renewing contracts for firm biomass power plants
Complaint about the effects of a small hydropower dam, Nan
Greenhouse gas reduction policy with hydrogen and ammonia

te: Studying the national energy plan, the power development plan (PDP) and the gas plan
se: The committee held a study session on the national energy strategy and the direction towards carbon neutrality, including the power development plan (PDP) and the natural gas management plan, with the Energy Policy and Planning Office (EPPO) explaining issues such as rising energy demand from data centres and climate change.
it: Study session on the national energy strategy, PDP and gas plan (EPPO)

te: Proposals on biomass power plants and reducing PM2.5 dust
se: The renewable energy subcommittee reported its draft findings on renewing contracts for firm biomass power plants, linked to reducing PM2.5 dust from burning sugar cane leaves, with proposals such as asking energy agencies to weigh the value of power purchase rates, promoting contract farming for buying cane leaves, and zoning sugar cane areas nationwide. The electricity prices subcommittee heard PEA on the power shortage complaint in Uttaradit, and the hydrogen subcommittee studied the cost of producing hydrogen from renewable energy.
it: Draft report on firm biomass power plants and reducing PM2.5 dust
Complaint about insufficient electricity, Uttaradit (PEA)
Cost of producing hydrogen from renewable energy

te: Learning the basics of electricity and power generation with EGAT
se: The committee held a study session on Thai energy on the basics of electricity and power generation (Basic Electrical Engineering & Power Generation), with EGAT explaining everything from the discovery of electricity and basic theory to power generation today.
it: Study session on the basics of electricity and power generation (EGAT)

te: Biomass power from sugar cane, too little electricity in a village, and hydrogen laws
se: The renewable energy subcommittee considered a draft report on a request from sugar industry associations to support renewing contracts for firm biomass power plants. The electricity prices subcommittee considered a complaint that the power supply is not enough for homes and government offices in a village in Uttaradit, and agreed to invite the Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA). The hydrogen subcommittee considered the scope of its study of legal measures for hydrogen and ammonia.
it: Draft report on renewing contracts for firm biomass power plants
Complaint about insufficient electricity in a village, Uttaradit
Scope of the study of legal measures for hydrogen

te: Progress of the three subcommittees, and preparing for small modular reactors (SMR)
se: The subcommittees on renewable energy, electricity prices and hydrogen reported their meeting plans and reports, such as promoting biomass, solar and waste-to-energy power, and studying laws on hydrogen. The committee then considered how to prepare for developing small modular nuclear reactor (SMR) power plants in Thailand, with the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) and other agencies invited.
it: Progress of the subcommittees (renewable energy, electricity prices, hydrogen)
Preparing for SMR power plants in Thailand (EGAT)
